additional_info.body:

I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0483046
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:

Main Asset:
MP / R4 170001720
Charger ID / Serial No.:
WDljXL
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Converter defekt
Following the procedure for diagnosing a power converter issue, and after our check, as shown in the screenshot I sent, we can see that converter number 14 is faulty.
First, check the CanCommLoss cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.

eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
